name: iSimangaliso Wetland Park – Maputo National Park
description: This vast stretch of coast runs along the Indian Ocean from northern KwaZulu-Natal in South Africa into southern Mozambique. Coral reefs, dunes, lakes, mangroves and savannah lie within a few kilometres of one another. Turtles nest on its beaches, whales and whale sharks pass offshore, and pelicans, storks and herons gather in the wetlands. Its Zulu name, iSimangaliso, means "a miracle".
